reason: The indexed rhombohedral cell, Z=3, average thiospinel framework, and normal-spinel chemistry are strongly supported, and the submitted model gives a close peak-position and extracted integrated-intensity match with sensible bond lengths. Exact recovery is nevertheless not sufficiently established: the comparable whole-pattern score is unavailable, the trace did not perform a whole-pattern refinement, and it instantiated only one R-3m ordered derivative built from an averaged cubic analogue. It did not construct and quantitatively compare competing Ag/Nb/Cr ordering or occupational-disorder models, nor plausible lower-symmetry variants. Thus the claims that the submitted symmetry, full ordering, and refined coordinates are resolved exceed what was actually compared, and another attempt could materially improve the candidate set.
